ribbit-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections for the Ribbit base, re-applied on every rebuild. A merge folds a renamed company's older rendering (from the archived listings or a Form D legal name) into the row the firm lists today; the reason cites what ties them.

merges.name: EarnIn
merges.reason: one company: Activehours renamed EarnIn (2017); the firm listed it as Activehours 2014-2017 (activehours.com) and as EarnIn from 2018 (earnin.com)

merges.name: Gusto
merges.reason: one company: ZenPayroll renamed Gusto (September 2015); the firm linked zenpayroll.com in 2015 and gusto.com after

merges.name: Kiavi
merges.reason: one company: LendingHome renamed Kiavi (2021); the firm linked lendinghome.com 2015-2022 and kiavi.com from 2022

merges.name: Parasut
merges.reason: one company: the firm's 2014 list carried eDefter with the description it later gave Parasut ('cloud-based accounting and invoicing solutions that change how Turkish SMBs run their businesses'), then Parasut (parasut.com) from July 2014

merges.name: CAN Capital
merges.reason: one company: Capital Access Networks, Inc. trades as CAN Capital; the firm listed it by the legal name 2012-2014 and linked cancapital.com from late 2014

merges.name: Conta Azul
merges.reason: one company: the firm's ContaAzul / Conta Azul (contaazul.com), and its US holding company, which filed Form D as DVPJ Corp (2013-2016) and then as ContaAzul International Holdings Corp under the same CIK 1558991 (2018), Meyer Malka a related person throughout

merges.name: Nubank
merges.reason: one company: Nu Holdings Ltd. is Nubank's holding company (CIK 1691493), whose Form Ds name Meyer Malka

merges.name: Teya
merges.reason: one company: SaltPay renamed Teya (2023); the firm linked saltpay.co 2022-2025

merges.name: OnePay
merges.reason: one company: One (onefinance.com), the fintech Walmart launched with Ribbit in 2021, renamed OnePay (2024)

merges.name: Ideal Invest
merges.reason: one company: Pravaler is Ideal Invest's student-credit brand; the firm linked pravaler.com.br from 2023 in the slot it had given instituicao.idealinvest.com.br

merges.name: ROOT
merges.reason: one company: IBOD Company, Inc. is Root Insurance's original legal entity (Columbus, Ohio; officers Alexander Timm and Dan Manges), whose 2018 Form D names Nick Shalek a director

merges.name: Morse Money
merges.reason: one company: Sling Money (sling.money, Avian Labs, Mike Hudack and Simon Amor) renamed Morse Money; sling.money redirects to morsemoney.com (read 2026-09-28) and the live Rebels list names Morse Money with the same founders

merges.name: Daffy
merges.reason: one company: Aside, Inc. is the company behind the charitable giving app Daffy ('Aside, the company behind charitable giving app Daffy, has secured $17.1 million in Series A funding', Finovate 2022-02-09; daffy.org reads 'Powered by Aside'); the firm's archived Our Bets page carried both logos

merges.name: Axio
merges.reason: one company: Capital Float renamed axio in July 2022 (The Economic Times); the firm linked capitalfloat.com 2017-2025 and lists Axio (axio.co.in) today
